steps.source_text: Accept one treated adherent-cell well and one reference adherent-cell well.
Remove culture medium, wash each adherent-cell well twice with phosphate-buffered saline, lyse the cells, and collect each lysate.
Add binding buffer, mix each lysate, load it onto a silica column, and retain the column-bound material after centrifugation.
Wash each column, perform on-column DNase digestion, wash again, and elute purified RNA.
Record RNA quantity and purity readouts for each purified RNA sample.
Build reverse-transcription reactions for treated and reference RNA.
Incubate reverse-transcription reactions through priming, cDNA synthesis, enzyme inactivation, and hold steps.
Declare a qPCR plate layout with treated/reference, target/housekeeping, technical-replicate, and no-template-control wells.
Load cDNA, no-template water, target primers, housekeeping primers, and qPCR master mix into the assigned well groups.
Run qPCR activation and repeated denaturation/annealing-extension cycles while collecting fluorescence.
Run a melt-curve ramp over all assay wells.
Record a structured qPCR readout with well, sample, gene, replicate, Ct, melt-peak, control, variability, and QC fields; quantitative normalization remains downstream analysis.
